objects.name: Analytic 1879
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process on an Industrial Control System (ICS) Windows host injecting spoofed reporting messages into the Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) data path -- Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture (OPC UA) data change notifications with fabricated values, or historian tag writes that override device-sourced values -- from a process that is not the recognized data acquisition process. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: opc:applog
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Open Platform Communications (OPC) server data change notification or value write from client_id not matching authorized data acquisition service

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Acceptable divergence between primary and independent secondary measurement of the same physical quantity.
Time window over which reported values are checked for implausible stability.
